guard: an unattended custodian retains its record, and reap never treats a process identity as proof that descendants are gone
why: The orphan suite reaps both an unattended seat after its custodian exits and a setsid escapee whose descendant remains alive.

mutations.name: an unattended settled record is not reported reaped
mutations.expectRed: O1 a settled orphan reap retains the custody record
mutations.cell: O1 a settled orphan reap retains the custody record
mutations.note: Without cgroup proof, the stopped seat must remain retained.

mutations.name: a setsid escapee is not reported reaped
mutations.expectRed: setsid escapee retains the reap after its custodian exits
mutations.cell: setsid escapee retains the reap after its custodian exits
mutations.note: A grandchild outside the original session remains alive after the custodian exits.
